mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my primary suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for your primary suite addition, prioritize experience with similar projects, a strong portfolio, and transparent communication. Look for contractors who are licensed, insured, and have positive client references, particularly those familiar with local building nuances in places like Lafayette or Castro Valley. We recommend obtaining multiple detailed bids that clearly outline the scope of work, materials, and payment schedules. A reliable contractor will also offer a clear project management plan and timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in primary suite additions, a strong portfolio, and transparent communication. Ensure they are licensed, insured, and provide detailed bids.
